title: Summary Ranges
statement: `nums` is a sorted list of unique integers. Return the smallest sorted list of ranges that cover it. A range of one number is 'x'. A longer range is 'start->end'.
constraints: All values are unique and sorted
hints: A new range starts when the current number is not one more than the previous number.
Track the start of the current run and the previous value.
Flush the run at every gap and once more after the loop.

approaches.name: Groupby on differences
approaches.explanation: The same idea with consecutive differences.

editorial: Walk the sorted values. While each value is exactly one larger than the previous, extend the run. Otherwise emit the finished run and start a new one. A run of length one is emitted as a single number.
